definitions: The lower extremity of the leg, on which a person stands or walks.
A unit of length equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimeters.
The lowest part or base of something.
A metrical unit of verse, consisting of a stressed syllable and one or more unstressed syllables.
examples: The table has a broken foot.
The foot of the mountain was covered in snow.
The poem has an iambic foot.
